# FBX test fixtures

Generated by `tools/make_fixtures.py` **inside Blender 4.5 LTS**; do not edit by hand. Plan: `15` §5.

## Regenerate

```bash
PYTHONHASHSEED=0 /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --factory-startup \
    --python-use-system-env --python-exit-code 2 \
    --python tools/make_fixtures.py -- tests/fixtures/fbx
```

Add `--check` after the directory to regenerate into a temp dir and compare the structural summaries
(`tools/fixture_probe.py`) with the committed files instead of overwriting them (exit 1 on drift).

Determinism: the geometry, weights, UVs, textures and keys are built without randomness. Blender's FBX
exporter derives element UUIDs from Python's `hash()` (salted per process unless `PYTHONHASHSEED` is
set, which Blender only honours with `--python-use-system-env`) and writes a `CreationTimeStamp`.
With the command above only the three timestamp bytes (second / millisecond) in the header differ
between runs; without the seed roughly 1 KB of UUID bytes differ too. The exporter also embeds the
absolute path of the texture next to the relative one, so regenerating from another checkout location
changes those bytes as well (the importer resolves the relative path first).

## Common rig

All four files contain one armature object **`Armature`** with the connected chain
`Root (0,0,0)→(0,0,0.5)` → `Spine →(0,0,1.0)` → `Head →(0,0,1.5)` (+Z up in Blender, 0.5 units each).
Exported with the pipeline's `FBX_EXPORT_KWARGS` (plan `12` §1.2): `add_leaf_bones=False`,
`apply_scale_options="FBX_SCALE_ALL"`, `bake_anim_use_all_actions=True`, `path_mode="RELATIVE"`,
`embed_textures=False`, `axis_forward="-Z"`, `axis_up="Y"`.

## Files

| File | Size | Mesh | Action (24 frames, keys) | Texture / material |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rigged_cube.fbx` | ~57 KB | `Cube`: 26 verts, 24 quads (48 tris), default cube cross UVs (`UVMap`, non-overlapping), skinned | `idle`: Spine X 0°/5°/0°, Head Z 0°/−8°/0° at frames 1, 12, 24 | `cube_mat` → `cube_texture.png` (4×4, 4 colour quadrants) |
| `rigged_cube@walk.fbx` | ~43 KB | none (companion clip) | `walk`: Spine Y ±10° at 1/8/16/24, Head X ±15° at 1/12/24 | none |
| `palette_cube.fbx` | ~57 KB | same cube; every face of a cube side collapsed onto one 0.02×0.02 UV quad inside a palette swatch (24 unique UV points, overlap ratio 1.0) | `idle` | `palette_mat` → `palette.png` (16×4, 64 distinct colours) |
| `shapekey_cube.fbx` | ~60 KB | same cube + shape keys `Basis`, `blink` (top vertex ring moved −0.2 Z) | `idle` | `cube_mat` → `cube_texture.png` |

Skin weights: bottom ring → `Root` 1.0; middle ring → `Root` 0.25 / `Spine` 0.75; top ring →
`Spine` 0.25 / `Head` 0.75. Every vertex is weighted.

## What Blender's importer makes of them (`FBX_IMPORT_KWARGS`, plan `09` §2.6)

Verified by `tests/integration/blender/test_fixtures_load.py`:

- Actions are named `<object>|<take>` and the take is already `<object>|<action>`, so the imported
  names are `Armature|Armature|idle` / `Armature|Armature|walk` (frame range 1–24, 39 F-curves).
- `shapekey_cube.fbx` additionally yields a one-curve action `Key|Armature|idle` for the baked
  blend-shape channel.
- Textures resolve through the relative path (`use_image_search=True`), sizes 4×4 and 16×4.
- The rest pose is identical in all four files, including the mesh-less clip (the generator unassigns
  the action before export; otherwise the exporter writes bone nodes from the current pose and an
  armature without skin clusters imports with that pose as its rest pose).
